text: 2026-08-03 follow-up: the DMS full-schema integration exposed a real combine bug: DesignSchema.combine dropped eventProvenance when merging event and baseline schemas, so model/fit fingerprints silently lost phase/source provenance. Added eventProvenance concatenation to combineAudits and a DesignSchemaSuite regression. JVM DesignSchemaSuite 11/11 and JS 11/11 pass; DMS JVM/JS scenario also confirms 240 provenance entries survive the combined model schema. P3.1 remains open for broader phase-specific assignment/validation and external parity.
